findings.title: Missing cache re-check after acquiring write lock
findings.body: GetWebAssets reads entryPointAssetsCache under RLock, releases the lock, and then acquires the write lock without re-checking whether another goroutine has already populated the cache. In non-development mode this allows multiple concurrent initial callers to all perform the manifest load sequentially. More importantly, a caller that observed a nil cache before another goroutine populated it can still run the load path and, if that load fails, the unconditional assignment at line 69 can overwrite a valid cached value with nil. Re-check entryPointAssetsCache after acquiring the write lock for non-dev mode, and/or avoid replacing a valid cache when the reload fails.

findings.title: Global write lock held during manifest I/O
findings.body: The write lock acquired at line 48 is held while reading assets-manifest.json from disk, and would also be held during the CDN HTTP request if that path were enabled. This serializes all GetWebAssets callers during I/O; in development mode, where the cache fast path is bypassed, every request can be forced through this locked file read. Consider performing I/O outside the lock, using singleflight, or only locking when publishing the cached result.
